about.text: Mongolian milk spirit, distilled from fermented cow's or yak's milk (tarag) in a still of a cauldron, a wooden barrel and a second pot of cold water, to about 10–16 % alcohol. Rarer than airag, it is opened with an offering to the spirits.

links.name: Bianquis, Les alcools de lait en Mongolie (OCHA, 2004)

facts.v: Boiled raw yak milk + yoghurt, fermented 24-48 h, distilled from day 10-15, 18 % abv
Mostly rural and home-made by herding families, sometimes shared with city relatives
